description: Unofficial Pteri fan-art companion from Neopets. Original yellow bird artwork with a pale belly, simplified three-lobed crest and feathered tail. Pteri dips and resets its crest, presents and steadies a soft paper fan, steps around a flat rounded foam disk, moves in three directions and makes a wing-assisted hop. The safe foam disk replaces a research thumbtack idea; these are original animations.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
